messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: [P1] Velox (vpc-velox-prod) network isolation detected. Pages: @jen @mike @tom. Incident channel created: #incidents. Run mitigation playbook: vpc-isolation.
jen: ack, on my way. collecting initial logs.
mike: oncall here. seeing egress failures to S3 in the velox VPC. heatmap shows spike at 02:12 UTC.
tom: confirming, kv-store replicas failing cross-AZ. probable network ACL change or route table flap.
jen: running /runbook vpc-isolation step1: check control plane connectivity. command: `kubectl --context=velox-prod get nodes -o wide`
ops-bot: Deploy bot: Rolling restart of velox-worker pool initiated (reason: emergency isolate).
mike: Do not restart all at once. Start draining 2 nodes to validate mitigation. I'll prepare warm pool.
jen: draining node i-0a12abcd now. redirecting traffic to warm pool velox-warm-1.
tom: I see tenant 'velox-enterprise' usage concentrated on dedicated pool 'velox-pool-a'. We need to confirm isolation of other tenants.
lina: I've run tenant audit: no cross-tenant KV leakage. other tenants unaffected but degraded latencies observed.
mike: Mitigation working: packet drops drop from 30% -> 3% after draining nodes. Keep monitoring for 15m.
amy-cs: Customer impact assessment: Velox reported 5-10% request failures for ~20 minutes. They opened a support case at 02:17 UTC. Preparing comms.
jen: Good. Please prepare a short customer update we can send ASAP. Suggest: acknowledge incident, mitigation, ETA for RCA, offer credit if SLA breach.
amy-cs: Draft below — please review:

```Dear Velox team,

We're investigating a networking issue that affected your dedicated VPC (vpc-velox-prod) between 02:12–02:32 UTC on 2026-03-10. We routed traffic and recovered connectivity; request success rates are back to normal. We're preparing a detailed RCA and will propose credits if SLA thresholds were exceeded.

Sincerely,
Redwood Support
```
tom: Suggest adding that we isolated the root cause to a misapplied route update in a shared infra config and that we've rolled back the change.
mike: Confirm root cause only after full postmortem. For now say 'a configuration update in the networking layer'.
lina: I've captured PCAPs and control-plane logs and uploaded to logs.redwood/internal/velox/5298765432. Added correlation ids.
jen: Handoff: I'm going offline in 25m. Mike will own live mitigation and customer comm approvals. @mike take it.
mike: Taking over. I'll coordinate with SRE lead for RCA. SRE-lead, can you triage post-incident analysis and exec summary?
sre-lead: On it. I'll schedule a 1h RCA in 2h and prepare an exec brief plus possible credit calc. Need TPS and error-rate graphs from observability.
amy-cs: Customer comm plan: ASAP note to customer (sent), followed by 48h detailed RCA, and exec brief if they request. If SLA crossed >99.9% we propose 10% monthly credit — pending legal approval.
ops-bot: Alert: incident severity downgraded from P1 -> P2 at 02:45 UTC based on mitigation success.
mike: Thanks. Logging actions: drained 2 nodes, rolled back recent infra route update, warmed pool activated, KV replica re-sync started. Documenting in incident tracker.
amy-cs: I'll draft an executive-friendly one-pager and share in #customer-success once SRE-lead provides RCA root cause text.
jen: closing live mitigation bridge. if anything regresses, please reopen and page @jen @mike. good job team :thumbsup:
